title: Mountain Bike, card C: tip the bike
kaylee: No wheel on screen: she grabs the bike and tips it, and how far it tips is how hard it carves. Tip it all the way and Maple sticks a foot out and skids.
questions: Is tipping the bike easier for her than the wheel (yes or no)?
Is the foot-out skid fun or too much (fun or too much)?

pictures.title: Tipping right, left, then letting go
pictures.caption: The bike rolls toward her finger at once; on a full tip her inside foot comes out.

pictures.title: When she's stuck
pictures.caption: The hint hand sits on the bike and slides sideways.
